scope: Exactly four A4116 R256 streams, two predeclared sensor permutations, original baseline and depth settings. Diagnostic evidence only; no seed averaging/selection or reference-family qualification.
threshold: max(0.1 lx, 1% of the declared reference side); unchanged diagnostic criterion

checks.sensor_id_rule: s followed by (sensor_index+1) zero-padded to6 decimal digits

timing_scope: Actual sanitized host inventory is retained per job. Wall times describe these runs and are not portable benchmarks. Full raw matrices, recipes and detailed audits remain in digest-bound external artifacts.
